name: Black Rice (Forbidden Rice)
siboNotes: Well-tolerated by most SIBO patients as rice is easily digestible and FODMAP-free. Start with smaller portions if experiencing bacterial overgrowth symptoms.
preparationTips: Rinse thoroughly before cooking to remove excess starch
Soak for 30 minutes before cooking for better texture and digestibility
Use 1:2 ratio (rice to water) and simmer for 30-35 minutes
Let stand 10 minutes after cooking for optimal texture
nutritionalHighlights: High in anthocyanins (antioxidants that give the dark color)
Good source of fiber for digestive health
Higher protein content than white rice
